P17.name: Verify-on-stop guards

pointcut.context: The agent proposes completion after producing an artifact.
pointcut.trigger: A stop or finish action is requested.
pointcut.structure: Exit interception, verifier execution, and accept-or-continue result.
pointcut.effect: The stop is accepted only after the verifier reports sufficient evidence.

P17.requires: Stop can be intercepted and at least one verification is available.
P17.ensures: Failed verification returns actionable feedback or blocks completion.
P17.invariant: The same acceptance gate cannot be bypassed by another stop path.
P17.violation: Unavailable or flaky verifier yields explicit unknown or failure, not silent success.
P17.variation: Project test commands, acceptance hooks, verifier agents, and blocking policies.
P17.test_obligation: Test pass, fail-and-continue, verifier error, repeated stop, and bypass route.
P17.negative_control: Tests run by the user after the run are not verify-on-stop.
P17.evolution_question: Did completion verification become mandatory rather than advisory?

P18.name: Hybrid loop detection

pointcut.context: Successive agent observations or actions can repeat without progress.
pointcut.trigger: A loop signal crosses a configured threshold or composite condition.
pointcut.structure: Repetition signals, thresholds, and an intervention interface.
pointcut.effect: The harness diagnoses a loop and stops, redirects, or escalates.

P18.requires: Action or observation history is available in comparable form.
P18.ensures: Intervention is attributed to explicit evidence and recorded in the trace.
P18.invariant: A detector cannot block all exploration solely because outputs are similar.
P18.violation: Detector error, disabled mode, or false positive has a recoverable path.
P18.variation: Action repetition, observation similarity, semantic signals, and composite thresholds.
P18.test_obligation: Test exact repeats, productive variation, false positives, and intervention.
P18.negative_control: A recursion depth limit alone is not semantic loop detection.
P18.evolution_question: Did repetition detection move from prompt advice to executable intervention?

P21.name: Syntax-aware command permissioning

pointcut.context: An agent proposes a shell command with security-relevant structure.
pointcut.trigger: The command is about to be parsed, classified, or executed.
pointcut.structure: Shell parser, normalized command tree, policy evaluator, and execution handoff.
pointcut.effect: Authorization uses parsed operations and a parse failure cannot fall through to execution.

P21.requires: The command is representable by a parser or rejected before execution.
P21.ensures: Every subcommand and redirection is covered by a policy decision.
P21.invariant: Parsed intent and executed command refer to the same normalized operation.

P22.name: Policy floor

pointcut.context: Multiple general, project, user, or session policies are merged.
pointcut.trigger: A proposed action is authorized under composite policy.
pointcut.structure: Minimum floor rules, merge operator, and privileged override path.
pointcut.effect: Composition cannot weaken protected restrictions without explicit authority.

P22.requires: Rule identity and priority or set semantics are defined.
P22.ensures: The merged result is at least as restrictive as every floor obligation.
P22.invariant: Local customization cannot silently erase a protected deny rule.
P22.violation: Conflicts produce deny, escalation, or explicit configured precedence.
P22.variation: Intersection, ordered layers, scoped profiles, and administrative overrides.
P22.test_obligation: Test widening, conflicting rules, missing policy, and privileged override.
P22.negative_control: A single configurable allowlist has no composition floor.

P23.name: Layered permission and sandbox
P23.problem: Combine policy decisions with execution isolation.

pointcut.context: A tool action is evaluated by policy and executed in a controlled environment.
pointcut.trigger: A privileged operation or command is dispatched.
pointcut.structure: Authorization decision, sandbox profile, environment adapter, and enforcement point.

P25.name: Scope-based authorization and profiles

pointcut.context: A caller invokes a method or service with an operator, session, or agent identity.
pointcut.trigger: Capability is checked against a requested scope.
